# SparkPrep

> SparkPrep is an all-in-one self-publishing suite made by Legenddary (Sacramento, California). Authors design their book cover, format their inside pages, check both against the print rules of Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble Press and Lulu, fix the problems and download print-ready PDF/X-1a files in one place. Mottos: "SparkPrep: The Evolution of Self-Publishing" and "Power without complexity."

Key facts:

- The book file audit is free through December 31, 2026, with no sign-up. It shows every problem that could get a book rejected, where it is, and the printer rule it breaks.
- Cover Studio (free): full-wrap cover maker with 224 templates and 333 fonts, sized to each printer's real cover rules.
- Interior Studio (free): page formatter with Word import, 11 book styles and a live printed-page preview.
- The print check covers page size, bleed, margins, spine width, CMYK colors, the 240% ink limit, picture sharpness (300 DPI), fonts, template leftovers and ISBN mismatches. SparkPrep then fixes what it safely can.
- Founder: Joshua Davis, whose own book failed to print 18 times before he built SparkPrep.
- SparkPrep is independent and not affiliated with Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Barnes & Noble Press or Lulu.
